identity.reason: Separate plan and profile. The 1024-token experiment is not mutated into this one; different output ceiling means different workload identity.

authorization.note: Prepared only. No paid request has been sent for this pilot.

design.interleaving: Two back-to-back runs in one window, C=1 then C=2, so within-window drift affects both. Not randomised: with two runs an order can be stated outright.
design.ceiling_rationale: The ceiling is chosen to observe completion length, not to certify adequacy. Screening censored 117 of 120 at 256 tokens; the three natural completions (217, 222, 249) are a selected subset and do not identify the tail. 2048 is a declared probe value.
design.wall_time_basis: Screening 10K cells ran at 1.65-2.21 s/request at a 256-token ceiling. A 2048 ceiling permits roughly eight times the output, so per-request latency is expected to rise substantially. Planning estimate, not a measurement.

continue_only_if: zero ceiling truncations across both runs
actual HTTP attempts equal planned requests in each run
validated engine schema and raw evidence present in each run
provider-versus-target conformance within the profile tolerance
stop_rule.on_failure: Stop. Preserve all pilot artifacts. Report endpoint errors as outcomes. Review censoring, errors, budget and schedule, then version the plan before any further paid run.
prohibited: merging runs that used different ceilings
stop_rule.interpretation_limit: A clean pilot does not certify the ceiling. With zero censoring in 40 trials the one-sided 95% exact binomial upper bound on the censoring probability is 1 - 0.05^(1/40) = 7.22%. Dependence and temporal drift weaken that model further.

pricing_basis.note: Historical planning arithmetic. Re-verify pricing before executing anything.

cost.note: Client-side conservative bound on nominal exposure, not a provider billing limit and not a prediction of spend.

qualification.note: This pilot cannot qualify an endpoint. Pilot evidence is excluded from future qualification evidence.
